Name: Nyapu Style Gunther for Nora the Herpetologist
Author: den2nova
Description:
[b][size=4]📖 Description[/size][/b]

Replaces Gunther's portrait in the "Nora the Herpetologist" mod with a new version drawn in Nyapu's charming art style.

I love the Nyapu-style portraits and was happy to see that Nora already has one available. But since Gunther appears in the "Nora the Herpetologist" mod too, I felt he deserved a matching portrait in the same charming style—so I made one!
This mod replaces Gunther’s portrait in "Nora the Herpetologist" with a Nyapu-style version to match Nora’s. It’s a simple drop-in replacement that brings visual consistency if you’re using Nyapu’s portraits for other characters.

[line]
[b][size=4]🛠️ Installation

[/size][/b][list=1]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the ZIP file.
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Mods/[NPC] Nora the Herpetologist v.X.X.X/ and replace the [CP] The Herpetologist folder inside with the one from this mod.

[/list]
[/list][line]
